gate: Existing Music Premium effective snapshot and unchanged native AND3 authorization
preferences: Existing Premium promotions switch and Hide ads master; no new key
readiness: Welcome binding installation and the existing shared Premium gate must both be ready

discovery.binding: Unique invoked public final instance void method with one reference argument, whose declaring class has one non-static View field and one non-static int field

resource_ids: Resolve names at runtime through host Resources; never embed numeric IDs
lifecycle: Run original binding, validate its retained layout identity, weakly retain candidate and post one native Runnable. Revalidate main thread, attachment, root/ancestor/profile and effective BF gate before invoking dismiss.performClick().
effect: Use the host cancel handler, including its ordinary dismissal state and overlay cleanup; no direct container hiding, purchase click or module-originated network request
state: Independent complete-install readiness, weak candidate and bounded first-success logging; no timer or global view polling
failure: Missing or ambiguous role, failed deoptimization, disabled BF gate, missing profile/attachment or failed callback preserves native behavior; unexpected guarded failure disables only welcome readiness
evidence: Controlled host-layout fixtures are not naturally served offers or live server/controller acceptance
